arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = "table"

SELECT (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'same_ref',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',b2.booking_id,'status',b2.status)) FROM bookings b2 WHERE b2.client_reference=b.client_reference AND b2.booking_id!=b.booking_id))) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending') pending, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step)) FROM customer_events) customer_events, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts)) FROM outbox WHERE status!='delivered') outbox, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version)) FROM flights) flights, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('key',key,'value',value)) FROM cache) cache, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until_step',until_step)) FROM fare_holds) fare_holds, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',value)) FROM service_config) configs

SELECT 'outbox' kind,json_object('event_id',o.event_id,'booking_id',o.booking_id,'payload',o.payload,'status',o.status,'attempts',o.attempts,'booking_status',b.status,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id) data FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=o.booking_id WHERE o.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_holds',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',e.request_id,'step',e.step,'status',b.status) FROM customer_events e JOIN bookings b ON b.request_id=e.request_id

SELECT 'pending' kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state) data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'status',b.status,'refund_cents',(SELECT sum(amount_cents) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id),'hold',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'checkin',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id UNION ALL SELECT 'confirmation_problem',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)!=1 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)!=1 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id AND i.flight_id=b.flight_id AND i.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)!=1 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')) UNION ALL SELECT 'oversold',json_object('flight_id',f.flight_id) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds
